Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The AI tutor built to withhold the answer, and the second room, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

An asterisk at the foot of the page.

Above it, the University of Texas at Arlington describes an AI tutor that will not give a student the answer. It will offer a hint instead. Below it, a footnote says the system is already being tested with the Fort Worth Police Department on de-escalation training. That half is funded by the Department of Justice under its own grant.

The classroom half is on the record. Award 2539663 starts October 1st and runs to September 30th, 2029 across four undergraduate engineering courses.

The police half is thin. Neither source publishes a result. No federal record for that Justice grant was found.

The deck walks the Arlington classroom and the Fort Worth training room.

The grant number for the police work rests on that footnote alone. How much of that half is public anywhere else?

#UTArlington #FortWorthPolice #NSF

The first panel put it under the bar on all three lenses and the root cause was a measurement the run computed and never read: five of nine frames were outside the value band their own dossier declared while the storyboard asserted all nine were inside. measure_arc.py is that comparison now and every frame is inside its band.", "All three judges name one remaining improvement, figure-to-ground separation on frames 3 and 4 at feed size. It was deliberately NOT fixed, because the panel scored those exact pixels and changing the art after scoring would make score.json describe a deck that is not the one shipping. It is in the upgrade backlog.", "prompt_audit measured 1042 tool calls this run and none waited on a human." ]

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
